text:
Ava L: flagging a currency translation snag discovered during the month-end deferral tie-out. some EUR invoices were converted using the bank T+0 spot rate instead of our policy T+2 monthly average. looks like deferred revenue (EUR) translated at a lower USD amount, creating a mismatch.
Marcus D: can you paste sample invoices and the FX math?
Ava L: pasted excerpt from billing_export.csv:
```
invoice_id,customer,currency,amount_local,posted_usd,expected_usd,deferral_code
INV-2026-0901,eu-alpha,EUR,10000,10950,11020,DEF-SUB-12M
INV-2026-0913,eu-beta,EUR,4200,4599,4628,DEF-SUB-12M
```
Ava L: posted_usd = billed * T+0 spot (1.095), expected_usd = billed * monthly-average (1.102). total variance ~ $99 understate in deferred balance for Apr.
Omar N: materiality? small per invoice but aggregated across EUR ledger could be bigger. did you run rollup by currency?
Ava L: yes rolled up EUR deferrals: posted total deferred USD = 1,145,300; expected at policy = 1,145,399. variance = $99 across EUR bucket. wider set of invoices where cash posted in Apr but deferral translation used spot.
Marcus D: $99 below internal per-currency threshold but we need to check cumulative FX rounding across months. policy: translate deferrals using monthly average rate for the month of invoice. using spot creates timing variance.
Ava L: agrees. proposed remediation: 1) correct the translation method in the billing-to-GL ETL for future runs; 2) post a revaluation JE to adjust USD representation of deferred liability for Apr: DR 2300-DEFERRED-EUR $99 / CR 4000-FOREX-ADJ $99 with memo "FX translation correction - Apr deferrals"; 3) add footnote in May revenue schedule noting non-substantive FX revaluation.
Omar N: do we treat as prior-period adjustment? i don't think so given < materiality and pure FX reclassification/translation. treat as current-period reval in May. tax-bot: any tax consequences?
tax-bot: no immediate VAT impact. FX variance small and does not affect taxable base in local currency. record local currency amounts unchanged; USD-only translation adjustment ok.
Marcus D: ok i approve the JE. Ava, add the rate sources and sample math to the ticket and attach exchange rate table. also include a note that we fixed the ETL to pick monthly_average_rate instead of spot.
revrec-bot: ticket RR-2026-0678 created and assigned to @Ava L; due 2026-05-02; required attachments: billing export, FX table, ETL PR.
Ava L: PR to fix ETL: https://git.internal/redwood/billing-etl/pull/201 - will attach. will schedule small JE in May close window and add schedule footnote: "Minor FX translation revaluation due to correction of billing ETL rate selection (RR-2026-0678)."
Marcus D: thanks. keep an eye on EUR bucket weekly; if variance grows we escalate.
Ava L: will monitor next run and report differences. closing loop unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:
